description: Governor's Office - Western Province - Announce that the period of investigation of Single Person Inquiry Board Extended 3 months from 03rd June 2023
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns a judicial/law enforcement matter involving an inquiry into potential offenses by a local government body (Wattala-Mabola Urban Council) and its Chairman. It specifically deals with the extension of an investigation period conducted by a single-person inquiry board comprising a retired judge, under the Urban Councils Ordinance and Provincial Councils Act. This falls under judicial proceedings and law enforcement regulations rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
